title: Why Everyone Is Wrong About the Market Selloff
speaker: Brent (guest) with Jermaine (tastylive)

macro_themes.view: Selling is concentrated in tech while RSP/Dow/value outperform, so downside likely limited unless correlation and vol lift.
Watch fixed-strike vol, VIX9D and a flattening VIX term structure as warning of broader selling.
Monthly OPEX tomorrow could relieve put pressure and allow a rally early next week.
The big risk is credit (Oracle, CoreWeave); if credit falters, all equities fall sharply.

calls.condition: If SPX loses the 7690 risk pivot and vol lifts, expect a real selling move toward 7450 worst case (and he would play short); otherwise OPEX could bring a rally into early next week
calls.reason: 7690 risk pivot; rotation rather than broad selling; dips bought for 3 months; year-end seasonality strong.
calls.quote: I don't think it's over yet for the bulls

calls.reason: Pitching cheap Nov/Dec NVDA calls for upside exposure; market has nasty right tails and TSMC earnings were good.

notes: Date: hot CPI 'yesterday' and OPEX 'tomorrow' = Thursday 2026-10-15. Guest is 'Brent' (likely Brent Kochuba, SpotGamma; surname not said). '7890' slip corrected on air to 7690. ES worst-case 7450 is a scenario level, not a target.
